parts.explanation: Dubai leg duration = 30% of 18hrs = 5.4hrs = 5hr24min. Arrival in London time: 2:10pm+5:24=7:34pm. Convert to Dubai local time by adding the 4hr time difference: 7:34pm+4hrs=11:34pm.

parts.text: 2hr stop in Dubai; Singapore 9hrs ahead of London - find Singapore arrival local time
parts.explanation: Track everything in London time to avoid confusion: depart Dubai (London time 7:34pm + 2hr stop) = 9:34pm London time. Remaining flight = 18hr total - 5.4hr Dubai leg = 12.6hr = 12hr36min. Arrival in London time: 9:34pm+12:36 = 10:10am next day. Convert to Singapore local (add 9hrs): 10:10am+9hr=7:10pm, same calendar day as arrival in London-time terms (i.e. the day after departure).
